_doc: GH #16 / ADR-0700. Deployed-vs-authored Cedar policy parity. Pack-shaped policy DATA — nothing oyatie-specific is hardcoded in Rust. deployed_suffix selects the deployed ConfigMaps (every file whose repo-relative path ends with it); authored_subdirs are the per-capability subdirs holding the authored .cedar policy set (<cap>/<subdir>/*.cedar). CHECK-A flags any deployed permit whose HEAD leaves the action unconstrained (action-agnostic blanket grant). CHECK-B uses Cedar allow semantics: deployed permits must be authored, authored forbids must be deployed when deployed permits could otherwise allow a request, and default-deny means a deployed policy with no permits grants nothing. It fails closed when a deployed ConfigMap has no resolvable authored policy. baseline.paths plus baseline.policy_signatures grandfather only the GH #16 byte-identical blanket ConfigMaps whose path AND exact Cedar authorization signature match: each is skipped by CHECK-A/CHECK-B but is DOCUMENTED, time-boxed (remove_by), and SHRINK-ONLY — CDP-STALE-BASELINE flags a baseline path that is gone or whose signature changed so it must be dropped, after which it is fully checked. The baseline NEVER grows by automation (a new or changed deployed ConfigMap is checked in full), so the gate blocks regressions from the first commit while the blanket-disarm follow-up (re-point each live service at its real PBAC-core authored policy) shrinks the baseline to empty.
_resource_scope_doc: CHECK-A also flags a deployed permit whose head leaves bare `resource` and whose `when` clause has no resource/scope predicate. Broad production exceptions must remain in baseline with reason/remove_by/adr and exact policy_signatures; the baseline is audited, time-boxed, and shrink-only.

baseline.reason: GH #16 / GH #987 / AUTHZ-004: remaining legacy product-surface Helm Cedar ConfigMaps still carry the original byte-identical blanket and are grandfathered only by exact path+signature while their deprecation/reorg-safe disarm lands. The Cloud control-plane templates named in GH #987 have been repointed at their authored action/resource-specific PBAC policies and removed from this shrink-only baseline; AUTHZ-004 deleted the unused oya/analytics Helm Cedar ConfigMap because the chart deployment never mounted it. Do not add new baseline paths.
baseline._comment: 2026-08-18 chart-collapse reconciliation (PR #2103): the shared iac/charts/oyatie-microservice chart replaced the per-service Helm charts, deleting 57 of these 62 per-service cedar.yaml templates. A baseline entry for a path that no longer exists is not tolerated debt, it is a stale claim — the gate reports CDP-STALE-BASELINE for each. Dropped 57, 5 remain. Shrink only: no path was added, and any recreated template returns as a NEW finding rather than a pre-approved one.
